description: This PHP script implements OAuth2 authentication with GitLab, handling authorization flow, token retrieval, and fetching user profile data.

classes.name: Omines\OAuth2\Client\Provider\Gitlab
classes.description: OAuth2 provider class for GitLab, used to handle OAuth2 flow, token management, and user info retrieval.

methods.name: getAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Generates the URL to redirect users for GitLab OAuth2 authorization.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current OAuth2 state parameter for CSRF protection.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves an access token from GitLab using the authorization code.

methods.name: getResourceOwner
methods.description: Retrieves the resource owner (user) information using the access token.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts user resource data to an array.
